notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where invincibility time was not given correctly after a kill when playing with three or more players.
[*] Changed so that the player cannot be controlled after the game ends.
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where invincibility time was not given correctly after a kill when playing with three or more players.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added classes (Balancer, Shooter, Builder and Dodger)
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented two-step jumping when pressed quickly.
[/list]

tags.feature: Added classes (Balancer, Shooter, Builder and Dodger)

tags.bug: Fixed a bug that prevented two-step jumping when pressed quickly.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where key bindings were randomly reset.
[*] Key bindings are now synced with accounts.
[*] Added sound effect when matching.
[*] Added handling when matching fails.
[*] Now matches will be made regardless of rank point difference until the number of players increases (if there are multiple lobbies, players with close rank points will be matched)
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where key bindings were randomly reset.

tags.feature: Key bindings are now synced with accounts.

tags.balance_change: Now matches will be made regardless of rank point difference until the number of players increases (if there are multiple lobbies, players with close rank points will be matched)

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.3
notes.content: Fixed the endless loading bug that was occurring in some environments.

tags.bug: Fixed the endless loading bug that was occurring in some environments.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.2
notes.content:
Changed the cursor movement range to only within the window.
Custom mode lobby passwords are now saved.
Reduced the volume of the game on first launch.
Fixed a bug that caused Ranked Matches and Custom Matches to match.

tags.feature: Custom mode lobby passwords are now saved.

tags.balance_change: Reduced the volume of the game on first launch.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug that caused Ranked Matches and Custom Matches to match.
